type.provenance: This bill would similarly prohibit any person from manufacturing, distributing, selling, or offering for sale in the state any menstrual products that contain regulated PFAS

who.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS

action.provenance: A person shall not manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state a menstrual product that contains regulated PFAS

products.provenance: Menstrual product means a product used to collect menstruation and vaginal discharge

intentionally_added.provenance: Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or regulated PFAS means the following: (1) Commencing January 1, 2025, PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product
